ideas.title: The Federal Reserve's Role in the US Economy
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Federal Reserve's role in the US economy, including its relationship with the Justice Department and the implications of the Powell probe.
ideas.angle: Investigative analysis of the Federal Reserve's role in the US economy
questions: What is the Federal Reserve's role in the US economy?
How does the Powell probe impact the Federal Reserve's relationship with the Justice Department?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant insights into the Federal Reserve's role in the US economy and its relationship with the Justice Department. By following the money and analyzing the Powell probe, we may uncover patterns of corruption or abuse of power.
